_how: null means pending: the slide shows TBD and a grey 'result pending' mark. Fill a value, run build_endsem_pptx.py again, and the number appears. A slide loses its pending mark when none of its values is null.
_outcome: Slide 16. One of works, mixed, fails, inconclusive, as the registered rules decide. null shows all four alike.
_table871: Slides 6 and 7. After the 871 reruns and the rescore, point paper_compare_json at the new file and set table871_updated to true. The 'to be updated' marks then go away and the 871 budget is read from the new file.

asp853_full_budget._what: Slide 7, row 'ASP to the full budget on 853'. Mean F1 x 100 at 10, 50 and 100% of the budget, from the new ASP runs. Leave null if the runs are not made.

base_rates._what: Slide 10. Re-derived under the frozen truth rule. Share of stages (0 to 1) in which an unseen region of that type remains; share of the LLM's new rooms that are bedrooms or bathrooms.

room_test._what: Slide 11. Rooms predicted before they were found, by the paper's rule (at least 2 of 8 samples within 2.5 m, same type): hits and rooms counted. Live arms have 8 members. Claude replays have 4: 1-of-4 and 2-of-4.

models._what: Slide 12. For each model and level: lift = model rate minus the strongest comparator's rate, in percentage points, with its 95% interval; verdict is Supported, Rejected or Inconclusive.

factorial._what: Slide 13. Spearman rho between ASP's score and the true unseen count in view, per arm, with the 95% interval by run. share_kept is (F3 - F5) / (F1 - F5).

validity._what: Slide 14. Per model: removed_share of guesses (0 to 1); L3 hit rate (0 to 1) of kept and of removed guesses; Brier score of support against truth; yield at tau 1.0 = hits kept / guesses kept.
